vow.text: i will not run from dragons

monster.name: Vex
personality: An ancient yellow dragon, proud, vain and clever. Speaks grandly and looks down on mortals.
monster.values: Expects a bold party worthy of a dragon. Disgusted by running away and by cruelty to the helpless; pleased by brave victories against strong foes and by treasure.

state.promise: The party swears to Vex: "i will not run from dragons"

instructions.question: How does `monster.name` feel about the promise in `promise`?

criteria.line_0: Hmm. You show a flicker of worth.
criteria.line_1: Well struck. I am... mildly impressed.
